scripts.postbuild:win: npm run repair:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.postbuild:mac: npm run repair:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.postbuild:linux: npm run repair:package:native && npm run rebuild:native:node
scripts.test:wave1: node test/test-search-engine-lifecycle.js && node test/test-mcp-http-save-parity.js && node test/test-mcp-tool-parity.js && node test/test-settings-indexing-contract.js && node test/test-window-navigation-history-contract.js
scripts.test:wave2: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const tests=['test/test-wave2-ledger-contract.js','test/test-wave2-embedding-settings-contract.js','test/test-wave2-mcp-contract.js','test/test-wave2-smart-search-contract.js','test/test-wave2-import-adoption-contract.js','test/test-wave2-source-scanner-contract.js','test/test-wave2-redaction-recovery-contract.js','test/test-wave2-package-contract.js','test/test-native-rebuild-manager-contract.js','test/test-opened-markdown-registrar-contract.js','test/test-package-smoke-launch-options.js','test/test-indexing-status-performance-contract.js','test/test-settings-status-poller-contract.js','test/test-status-coalescer-contract.js','test/test-startup-index-recovery-memory-contract.js','test/test-release-workflow-contract.js']; let failed=0; for (const t of tests) { console.log('wave2:', t); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,[t],{stdio:'inherit'}); if ((r.status ?? 1) !== 0) failed++; } process.exit(failed ? 1 : 0);"
scripts.test:release-regression: npm run test:wave1 && npm run test:wave2 && node test/test-search-index-worker-contract.js && node test/test-search-index-worker-benchmark-contract.js
